data.name: Avanisha
data.gender_notes: Avanisha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Avanisha is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'ava' meaning 'towards' and 'nis' meaning 'inner self' and 'shakti' meaning 'power'. This name signifies the inner joy and radiance that one experiences when they connect with their inner self. The name Avanisha carries the meaning “Joy, Radiance” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Avanisha usually hope their child will grow to embody joy, radiance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Connecting with one's inner self and experiencing joy and radiance
data.etymology: Avanisha belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joy, Radiance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Avanisha total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
